tara_cs: Morning team  we have a sudden enrollment surge for the CUSP preview. 7 new orgs accepted in last 24h and seats are tight. Need fast ops + flag gating.

leo_ae: Which orgs? any procurement holds?

tara_cs: New acceptances: NimbusAI (confirmed), HalcyonMed (procurement), Gridline (confirmed), EchoFoundry (confirmed), Palisade (pending legal), VelaTech (confirmed), ForgeOne (pending billing).

sana_prod: Proposal: open two extra kickoff slots next Tues to handle the wave. Also mark HalcyonMed and Palisade as "legal follow-up" and don't provision until cleared.

devon_ops: Ops: I can provision 4 seats immediately. I'll reserve 2 seats for pending legal/billing for 48h and add a retry workflow if provisioning fails. Adding a PagerDuty automation for provisioning error >2 attempts.

flagbot: Flag task created: enable cusp_preview_wave_7 for confirmed orgs once roster approved.

tara_cs: Action list: @leo_ae confirm final list by 5pm PT; @devon_ops provision immediate seats and queue pending holds; @sana_prod add a one-pager for AEs about renewal-signal questions. I'll send outreach with new slots after roster locked.

leo_ae: Will ping legal for Palisade and billing for ForgeOne now. If either blocks past 48h, free the seat for next cohort.

devon_ops: Done. Provisioning queued. I will post back when jobs succeed or if PD triggers.

tara_cs: Thanks  keep this thread for updates. If any org shows low pre-kickoff survey completion after 24h mark them as "engagement risk" and we escalate.

flagbot: Kickoff slots doc: https://docs.redwood.example/cusp-wave7-slots (perms: customer-success, ops, product).
